tasks.title: Preserve private history and create clean public root
tasks.body: Capture all current non-ignored work on a temporary private branch, create and verify a protected external Git bundle, build a new public root history without private/generated material, then remove private local refs after the publication gate passes.

tasks.title: Establish canonical maintainable repository tree
tasks.body: Keep one package source tree, formal tests/migrations/scripts, project-owned Shujuan agent/Codex surfaces, and curated durable docs; exclude zhanggong, build, release, egg-info, desktop archives, raw dumps, probes, caches, and historical execution packets.

tasks.title: Harden credential handling and privacy gates
tasks.body: Restrict credential-file ACLs at creation and for the current file, confirm live credentials/tokens/private keys are absent from public Git and database content, and keep values out of logs and reports.

tasks.title: Reconcile and conservatively clean local runtime state
tasks.body: Preserve the live PostgreSQL cluster and every explicitly or implicitly referenced artifact; back up then remove/archive only files proven unreferenced, while reporting existing missing provider references.

tasks.title: Reconcile packaging and verify GitHub readiness
tasks.body: Update ignore/package/manifest surfaces for the canonical tree, use GitNexus directly, run a repeatable publication privacy gate plus focused package/runtime checks, and stop before remote creation or push.

checks.body: A temporary private snapshot branch and external Git bundle pass verification before history replacement; after the public gate passes, local private refs and unreachable objects are removed while the protected external bundle remains complete and recoverable.
The public tree contains only documented canonical top-level surfaces and has no unexplained root files/directories.
Git tracks no zhanggong surface, build, egg-info, generated release, provider index, runtime database, dump, temporary prompt/probe, or private desktop archive content.
The public history contains no raw database dump, excluded historical material, user-profile path, non-approved author email, or live credential/token/private key.
The current and newly created PostgreSQL credential files have no broad read/write ACL and remain readable by the owning runtime context.
Boundary-aware scans find no live GitHub/OpenAI/AWS/private-key/current-database credential in the public tree, public history, or database content.
Every database file reference that existed before cleanup still resolves; the four pre-existing missing provider references are reported separately and not misclaimed as repaired.
PostgreSQL remains ready and schema status remains current after ACL/runtime cleanup.
Focused PostgreSQL credential/runtime tests plus package, install-layout, manifest, and smoke checks pass or any baseline failure is explicitly separated.

Direct GitNexus detect-changes, the repeatable main-object publication gate, root-structure audit, privacy scan, and git status confirm a clean publishable local branch with no zhanggong surface; no remote exists or is pushed.
